Name: Glarglewash
Description: Recommended Level: 6-8 Description: The humid jungle surrounding the now-half-collapsed Mt. Yalsanat volcano is a testament to the exuberance of nature, and its power to bounce back from disaster greater than ever before. Following the eruption, life has sprung into every nook and cranny of this mountain, making it a dangerous but rewarding adventure to explore. In addition to a number of useful chemicals and herbs, miners will want to seek out these slopes for the rare and valuable ores that can be found. Enemies: Kobald, Steam Elemental, Jarl Gekko, Drop Bear, Yellow-Paw Monkey, Bird of the Sun Herbs: Yellowberry, Chalkadonny, Silverfrond Ores: Iron, Gold, Aluminum, Cobalt, Mithril Chemicals: Sulfur, Morte Gas
